verdict.rationale: The Drive API exposes a permissions resource on every file, folder and shared drive. Its types include 'anyone' as well as user, group and domain, and it sets roles, so link-style visibility sharing is programmable. The pack does not evidence password protection or expiry settings for shared links, and revocation is only implied by the permissions resource model. Missing for 10: password-protected links, link expiry settings, explicit documentation of revoking/deleting permissions via API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
